Core.purpose: Shared platform: DB layer (q/q_val/q_one/db_insert/now), helpers (setting/e/url/money), bootstrap, schema, layout/theme, auth/account pages, inventory/items, updater and upgrade steps. Every other section depends on it one-way.

Player & Progression.purpose: Second-tier shared hub: the player's gnome, XP/callings/perks, rewards (petals), tools/equipment tiers, hollow clock and goals. Called by almost all gameplay sections.

Trek.purpose: Chapter-based Trek game: camps, fights, levels, knacks, events, old camp, chapter 1-3b data and text passes. Most self-contained gameplay section.

Roads & Expeditions.purpose: Roads, stops, exploring and the adventure/expedition engine (adventure.php, explore, destination, journey, road life, stop acts and text).

Garden & Almanac.purpose: Garden, yard, flowers, almanac, pests, critters/animals, breeding, gathering, climate and crop data.

Catfish.purpose: Catfish game and pet shops: catfish.php engine, pets, API, art/recolor tools and sims.

Delve & Pal Boons.purpose: Delves (floors, chambers, maps, routes, stamps, v2), pal boons and their data, lint tools, sims and content drafts.

Puzzles & Pals.purpose: Puzzle games, jigsaw, puzzle pals, pal jobs, player jobs, mini games and pal rosters.

Economy & Crafting.purpose: Markets, crafting, pantry, gourmand, alchemy, trade, sinks, fairs/festivals, contests, shelves and shop data.

World & Social.purpose: Towns, townsfolk/villagers, world and region maps, landmarks, social/friends/community, letters, onboarding, mentors, moderation and region data.

Admin.purpose: Admin console pages (CRUD, jigsaw, road/trek text, settings, retention, usage) and admin helper/menu includes.

Live Browser Tooling.purpose: Impeccable live-browser skill: live-browser.js, DOM/session scripts, reference docs, plus .github agents. Independent of the game.

Tests & Build Tooling.purpose: CI workflow, cross-cutting tests (security, health, updater, shots, schema), art-generation scripts (gen_ico_*, gen_ph_*, hearth) and build helpers.

Docs & Design.purpose: Planning docs, specs, art briefs, handoffs, todo, changelog, README, mock HTML and draft content under claude/ and docs/.

connectors.contract: World supplies maps/landmarks/npc_icon/place_known/events APIs and Roads supplies exp_log/player_node/active_expedition state; agree on the node/place slug schema and event-effect payload.
Economy calls world.php can_reach/place_ui town orders and trade.php notify(); both sides share the town/place slug and the order_deliver/notify signatures.

bridges: Per-place pal rosters (haven, wonder, delve, lair) (i/data/puzzle_pals.txt)
connectors.contract: Puzzle pals/games depend on landmark_day/landmark_scene_slug and region/place rosters (puzzle_pals.txt vs landmarks.txt); contract is place slugs and pal-roster format.

Economy reads garden building/bonus and shelf/bag state (user_building_bonus, sh_bag_entries) and Garden spends energy and judges quality for contests/fairs; contract is the building-bonus and item-quality functions.
Garden code (garden_logic ts/spend_energy) is called by community/social169 and Garden reads region_by_slug and place notes from world.php; contract is region slugs and the energy/time helpers.
player_jobs/jobs tend_action drive garden_logic plots and pest.php finishes via games.php; contract is the plot-load/tend/harvest function signatures and job_event payload.
adventure.php combat (combat_turn, gnome_combat, fight_snacks) uses Trek's combat_math.php and trek_fight.php; contract is the combat_math function set and fight result shape.
jobs.php/pal_jobs.php rewards flow into contests/fair/alchemy and trade notify(); contract is job_period_key/job_event and the notify() signature.
explore/journey call garden_logic time/energy helpers and gathering.gather_on_walk, and adventure.php calls almanac milestones; contract is spend_energy/ts and gather_on_walk.
delve_v2.php reuses adventure.php scene/log/find functions (exp_scene, exp_log, give_find); contract is the adventure scene and loot API.
